blindness_statement: Read only identity_batch_4.json and required AGENTS/SCHEMA/QUEUE. No canonical record/evidence rows, sealed sampler evaluation metadata or other audit results read. Existing identity names/address/domain were search keys only. Verdicts are independent and frozen before comparison.
method: Search results used as discovery only; substantive pages/documents opened. Source dates preserved; undated pages are not dated production inspections. primary_fetch_count counts distinct primary resource routes including failed attempts; repeated open/find of same resource is one route. Commercial reseller and EDC directory excluded from primary count. No closure/nonexistence REJECT, so EFAST2 reject gate was not invoked. Ring values are recommendations applying existing schema, not new owner rulings. Unresolved legal/parent questions not self-settled.
